{{BossList|Default|Ref = Only the first '''Mandragora''' that spawns is a [[Boss]].}} }} ==Description== The '''Mandragora''' is a tanky enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has high health and below average speed. It always spawns with [[Health Regen]], making it regenerate 2% of its health every two seconds, and also the [[Freeze Immunity|Freeze]] and [[Stun Immunity|Stun]] immunities, making it harder to stall. ==Logbook Description== "''It was wondered whether the plants of the Void had sentience, up until the Mandragora was found. It seems the flowers had completely overtaken a corpse as a host and bloomed. They do not speak or do much. When they move, they sound like rustling leaves. They will lie in a field with the Void Brutes to feel more connected to the Void, and to remember what it was like to be grass.''" ==Appearance== The '''Mandragora''' is a grey corpse that has been overtaken by flowers. It is covered in various purple plants, some of which form a new head over the corpse's actual head. This new head has an eye on its left side. ==Strategy== *DPS towers like the [[Kingpin]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] or [[Engineer]] can be used to take this down. **Support towers like the [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Medic]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. *Due to its immunities, freeze towers cannot be used to freeze it or slow it down. **Stunning towers will only slow it down instead of stunning it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Mandragora''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} MandragoraCA.png|'''Mandragora''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MandragoraIconIG.png|'''Mandragora''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Mandragora''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Mandragora''' added. ==Notes== {{Hardcore|[[Elite Phantom]]|Wave 23|Mandragora|Wave 26|[[Void Rusher]]|Wave 27}} {{Voidcore|[[Void Titan]]|Wave 30|Mandragora|Wave 31|[[Elite Mystery]]|Wave 33}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
